Maria P: Quick thread 7 -- Priya's Checkr status says 'Pending docs' and notes 'ID image unreadable'. She's due to start Mon 4/27 and needs badge day 1.
Jamal - People Ops: Ok. Which document did Checkr flag? Passport or driver's license?
Maria P: Passport. She uploaded a scanned PDF but it looks like two photos merged; portal says cannot verify.
Priya S: I can resend. Is there a preferred file type/size? I was attaching via mobile.
Jamal - People Ops: Secure upload accepts jpg/png/pdf, each file must be <10MB. If mobile compresses too much it can break the scan. Best is a single clear photo per side.
Priya S: Got it. I can re-upload this evening. If it fails, can someone pick up originals?
Alex (Facilities): We do same-day courier pickup for ID verification if needed. Need a signed release from the candidate authorizing collection. Courier window is 9:00-11:00 Mon.
Maria P: I've drafted a short release. Paste for signature:
```
I authorize Redwood Inference to pickup original ID documents at 1234 Market St Apt 5B on 2025-04-27.
Name: Priya Sharma
Phone: +1-555-9876
Signature: ___________________
Date: 2025-04-26
```
Maria P: Priya, can you sign (or type name as e-sign) and reply here? We need copy in Checkr notes.
Priya S: Signed (typed): Priya Sharma. Also re-uploading a single PNG now.
Onboard Bot: Auto-check 7: Uploaded document received, scanning in progress.
Jamal - People Ops: I updated Checkr employer contact to bg-intake@redwood.com and support number +1-555-2121. That should unblock the case.
Onboard Bot: Reminder: New hire orientation + badge pickup Mon 4/27 2:00pm, lobby. Please bring original government ID.
Alex (Facilities): Courier tentatively booked for 10:00. Maria, I'll confirm once courier has the signed release in hand. Escort will meet at reception.
Maria P: Release attached to candidate record and emailed to courier ops. Priya 1: please mark if plans change.
Priya S: All set, courier confirmed. Appreciate the quick turnaround :smile:
Jamal - People Ops: Benefits window is 30 days from start date; I'll DM you the enrollment steps and send invite to benefits orientation.
Maria P: Thanks team, closing loop :white_check_mark:
